sentences: The midnight train glided through empty tunnels of Seoul.
Lights flickered softly above silent rows of seats.
No announcements broke the stillness inside car three.
A lone glove lay folded near the window seat.
Its wool was damp, as if recently worn.
Steam rose faintly from the floor vent nearby.
My breath fogged the glass as I watched outside.
Buildings passed like ghosts in the dark.
Time felt stretched, neither forward nor back.
I checked my watch—it had stopped at 02:17.
The reflection showed no one else in the carriage.
Yet I sensed presence just behind my shoulder.
I turned quickly—only the hanging strap swayed.
A faint scent of green tea lingered in the air.
No vendor sold tea this late on the line.
The train slowed unexpectedly at a ghost station.
Platform lights were off, signs unreadable in gloom.
No doors opened, though we stood still for minutes.
Then motion resumed without sound or jolt.
I stood and walked toward the rear door.
The handle was cold, but unlocked when touched.
Outside, the platform breathed quiet mist.
Far down, a single red light blinked twice.
I stepped onto the concrete, alone and alert.
The train vanished silently into the dark tunnel.
No echo followed my steps on the wet tiles.
Signs pointed toward 동대문역사문화공원

sentences: The night train glowed softly through empty carriages.
Moonlight traced silver lines across polished floors.
Silence clung like fog between seats.
No announcements broke the stillness.
My breath echoed faintly in the dark.
A folded note lay tucked beneath my glove.
Ink smudged from rain or tears?
It read: “Meet me where the lights pause.”
I stood, heart beating slow but sure.
Doors hissed open at the next stop.
Platform lights flickered once—then steadied.
A shadow shifted near the pillar.
Not a soul stirred elsewhere.
Only the hum of rails below.
I stepped forward, voice barely a whisper.
“Who’s there?”
No answer came.
Just the distant chime of arrival.
The train exhaled and pulled away.
I remained, waiting for the sign.
Then the voice announced: 동대문역사문화공원

sentences: The midnight train glided through silent tunnels.
Flickering lights cast long shadows on empty seats.
A soft hum echoed beneath worn floorboards.
No announcements broke the stillness of the night.
Passengers sat still, eyes fixed ahead.
One figure stared out, breath fogging the glass.
Outside, Seoul slept beneath a veiled moon.
The carriage smelled of old paper and rain.
Time seemed to stretch between stations.
A single glove lay forgotten near the door.
Its fingers curled as if holding something lost.
No one claimed it, no one spoke.
The train slowed, brakes whispering like secrets.
Platform lights blinked in rhythmic pulses.
